text:
**Deforestation cannot be confirmed.** The evidence supports approximately 0.7 hectares of tree-cover loss on the 58.1-hectare asset in 2023, or 1.2% of its area.

Of that loss area, 0.4 hectares overlapped mapped eucalyptus plantations and 0.3 hectares lay outside mapped forest. Tree-cover loss can include plantation harvesting and does not by itself establish deforestation or land-use change. The cause is unknown.

An additional 0.4 hectares of loss was detected in patches below the 0.5-hectare event threshold.
